protocol: formal C1 external-media blocker audit v1

nonheld_cat_playing_inventory.anti_inflation_note: the Nairobi and Lotti series each contain two records but contribute one transitive source/session group

exhausted_local_routes: the exact 44-member Commons playing-cat category has been fully reviewed
Commons category, full-text, structured-data and multilingual deltas have no remaining high-confidence unseen title
the frozen poster and temporal priority queues produced no additional approved cat-playing group
the two strongest remaining multi-subject titles were reviewed over their full duration and rejected
VideoUFO sampled shards, Internet Archive, Figshare, GBIF, PeerTube and other first-party source audits yielded no further eligible non-held record
remaining strong metadata hits are multi-cat, eating/hunting, edited, rights-unclear or lexical false positives
blocking_condition: no additional provenance-locked, single-cat, continuously playing media from an independent animal/household/session is available in the audited workspace or approved public-source inventory

minimum_external_state_change.nonheld: four videos from four independently identified cats, households and capture sessions, with scene not indoors
minimum_external_state_change.held: thirty videos from thirty independently identified cats, households and capture sessions, with scene indoors
per_video_contract: rights receipt grants model training, derivatives and normalized-clip redistribution
locked original-media SHA-256 and recorded_at timestamp
full-duration review plus a no-cut two-second 16-frame action window
source/session grouping and pHash near-duplicate closure before split

resume_command_path: use prepare_local_contribution.py create/approve for each new media item, then rebuild from the fixed pristine base with all approved bundles and rerun prepare_real_data.py coverage
